text.en:
Subject to the ratification by the majority of the votes cast in a plebiscite to be held in the newly
created Municipality of Sto. Niño, Province of South Cotabato, the barangays of Sto. Niño, Guinsangan, San
Vicente, Panay, Manuel Roxas, Katipunan, and San Isidro are hereby separated from the Municipality of
Norala, and Barangays Ambalgan and Teresita are separated from the Municipality of Banga, and constituted
into a distinct and independent municipality in the same province to be known as the Municipality of Sto.
Niño. The seat of government of the new municipality shall be in the present site of Barangay Sto. Niño.
